reviews.author: ghs v
reviews.body:
This was one of the worst food-delivery experiences I have ever had. I ordered food through Zomato last night, my money was taken, but my food was never properly delivered. What makes the situation even worse is the way the customer support team handled the issue. The attitude, communication, and overall behaviour were extremely disappointing and completely unacceptable.

When a customer pays for an order, the basic expectation is that the food will actually be delivered. If there is a problem with the delivery, the company should take responsibility and resolve it properly. Instead, I was left dealing with a frustrating situation after already paying for my food.

The worst part was the behaviour of the support team. Instead of genuinely helping and understanding the customer’s problem, the communication felt careless and unprofessional. A customer should never feel like they are being treated as a problem simply because they are asking for help with an order they have already paid for.

I have used food-delivery platforms many times, but this experience has seriously damaged my trust in Zomato. Taking payment and then failing to deliver the food is simply not acceptable. Customers work hard for their money, and companies should respect that.

Honestly, after this experience, I would NOT recommend Zomato to anyone. If you are ordering food online, think twice before paying through Zomato. My experience was extremely frustrating, disappointing, and completely unacceptable.

For me, Swiggy has been a much better experience. Their service and customer handling have been far more reliable in my experience.

Zomato seriously needs to improve its delivery system and, more importantly, the way it treats customers when something goes wrong. Customer service is tested when there is a problem — and in my case, Zomato failed badly.

Very disappointed. Very poor experience. Not recommended.

reviews.author: SheikhEhmad
reviews.body:
This has to be one of the worst food-delivery experiences I’ve had. My food has been delayed for the FOURTH time in the last month, and every single time it follows the same frustrating pattern.

The delivery partner simply doesn’t respond. The app initially shows “20 minutes”, and then I end up waiting an hour and a half or more, with absolutely no meaningful update. When I contact customer support, instead of actually solving the problem, I’m repeatedly told to cancel the order.

Why should the customer have to cancel an order after waiting for 1–2 hours because Zomato failed to deliver it?

The most frustrating part is the complete lack of accountability. You waste your customer’s time, provide unrealistic delivery estimates, assign a delivery partner who doesn’t respond, and then expect the customer to simply cancel and accept the inconvenience.

This isn’t a one-off technical issue anymore. Four delayed/failed orders in one month is a pattern.

Zomato clearly seems to have forgotten that customers are paying for a service — and our time has value too. If you cannot deliver an order within a reasonable timeframe, don’t accept it in the first place.

Extremely disappointing service. Zero respect for the customer’s time, zero accountability, and absolutely no sense of urgency when things go wrong.

After this experience, I genuinely question why anyone should trust Zomato with their food or their time.

reviews.author: Shiraz_Ahmad
reviews.body:
Zomato has transformed my dining experience with its intuitive, user-friendly app that makes ordering food an absolute joy! From the moment I open the app, I’m greeted with a vibrant interface that’s easy to navigate, offering a mouthwatering selection of restaurants and cuisines tailored to my cravings. Whether I’m in the mood for gourmet sushi, hearty Indian classics, or a quick dessert fix, Zomato’s extensive catalog never disappoints.  

The delivery speed is consistently impressive—meals arrive piping hot and fresh, often earlier than expected. Real-time order tracking adds peace of mind, letting me follow my food’s journey from kitchen to doorstep. I’ve also been blown away by Zomato’s customer support team, who are quick to resolve any rare hiccups with professionalism and warmth.  

Special shoutout to the app’s smart recommendations and exclusive discounts! The “Top Picks” feature always introduces me to new favorites, while promo codes and loyalty rewards make every order feel like a steal. Plus, the one-click reorder option saves time on busy days.  

Zomato’s attention to detail—like eco-friendly packaging and partner restaurants with high hygiene ratings—shows they care about quality and sustainability. Whether it’s a lazy Sunday brunch or a last-minute dinner party, Zomato delivers (literally!) with flair.  

If you’re looking for a reliable, diverse, and downright delightful food delivery app, Zomato is a 5-star winner. Highly recommended! 🍴🌟

reviews.author: Sushant835
reviews.body:
This is, unfortunately, not the first time I’ve had a disappointing experience with Zomato. Delayed deliveries have become a recurring issue, with orders that are supposed to arrive in 30–40 minutes regularly taking well over an hour, sometimes even 90 minutes. It has reached a point where delays feel like the norm rather than the exception.

My latest experience was by far the worst. I placed an order that was estimated to be delivered within 40–45 minutes. I waited for over 2 hours, only to find out that the restaurant had handed my order to the wrong delivery partner. Instead of communicating with me or trying to resolve the issue, Zomato simply processed a refund on its own after making me wait all that time.

The refund does not make up for the two hours I lost waiting. Had I been informed earlier, I could have ordered from another restaurant instead of wasting my time hoping my food would arrive. What made the experience even more frustrating was the complete lack of communication and accountability.

To make matters worse, every time I contact chat support, I’m simply told to send an email. If the only purpose of chat support is to redirect customers elsewhere, then what is the point of having it in the first place? It offers no real-time assistance when customers actually need help.

After multiple similar experiences over the years, I’ve completely lost confidence in Zomato’s delivery service and customer support. Consistently late deliveries, poor communication, and a lack of meaningful customer resolution have made the platform increasingly unreliable. I sincerely hope Zomato starts valuing its customers’ time and improves both its logistics and support experience.

reviews.author: Anshu1301
reviews.body:
I’ve been a Gold member for a long time, and this experience has been extremely disappointing.
Some items were missing from my order. I called the restaurant, and they confirmed that they had handed over the complete order to the delivery partner. I then called the delivery partner, who said there was no issue from his end either. When I tried to contact Zomato support, there was no option to speak to a real person—only automated responses.
Instead of properly investigating the issue or providing a fair resolution, Zomato offered a coupon for missing item that could only be redeemed at the same restaurant within one month. Even when I tried to use the coupon on the same day for an order below the refund amount, I was still asked to pay platform fees and other charges, making the “refund” far from a real refund.
What is even more frustrating is that no one seems to care that customers order food based on the number of people they’re serving. Missing items can completely ruin a meal, and an automated coupon is not an acceptable solution.
Based on other reviews, I expect Zomato to respond here with the same generic, copy-paste reply instead of addressing the actual problem. Loyal customers deserve better support and accountability.

reviews.author: Rohini107
reviews.body:
The customer care service was not available when it was needed the most. My food was significantly delayed because of Zomato's unfair order management policy. Even after the delivery partner had picked up my order, it appeared to be deprioritized, resulting in an unnecessary delay. What's even more frustrating is that I was simply informed about the delay instead of any effort being made to resolve it.

To make matters worse, Zomato's cancellation policy is extremely disappointing. If the customer cancels an order due to excessive delays caused by Zomato's own processes, a refund is often denied. This creates the impression that customers are expected to either wait indefinitely or cancel and bear the loss. Such policies are unfair, customer-unfriendly, and completely unacceptable.

Customers pay for timely service and reliable support. Delayed deliveries, unavailable customer care, and a no-refund policy in situations caused by the platform only erode trust and confidence in the service.

reviews.author: Dr.Deshbandhu Rajput
reviews.body:
Dear Customer Support,

I am writing to express my disappointment regarding my recent order, which was supposed to be delivered within 20 minutes but was delivered more than 45 minutes later.

I placed this order specifically for my 3-year-old daughter. Unfortunately, due to the excessive delay, she had already fallen asleep by the time the order arrived, making it completely useless. No one else in my family eats waffles, so the entire order went to waste.

I contacted your customer support immediately, but I was informed that no refund or return could be processed because the delay was on the restaurant’s side. I fail to understand why I, as the customer, should bear the financial loss for a delay caused by the restaurant or your delivery partners. From my perspective, I placed the order through your platform and expected the promised service.

In addition to the wasted order, I was also delayed for work because I waited for the delivery based on the estimated arrival time shown in the app. This has caused unnecessary inconvenience and reflects very poorly on the service.

I request that you please review this case fairly and issue a full refund for this order. It is unreasonable to expect customers to pay for an order that became unusable solely because of a significant delay that was beyond their control.

I hope you will resolve this matter promptly and take appropriate steps to ensure such incidents do not happen to other customers.

reviews.author: Ash_vedi
reviews.body:
I have been a Zomato Gold member for years, and it’s disappointing to see how poor the food delivery service has become. This is not about a single incident—I’ve had multiple bad experiences with my orders.

Many times, after placing an order, I receive no updates for 30–60 minutes. I have to contact customer support myself to find out what’s happening. Only after I raise a complaint do they start investigating and discover issues with the restaurant or the delivery partner. Sometimes they assign a new delivery partner, sometimes the restaurant refuses to prepare the order, and the entire process becomes frustrating.

The worst part is that, after making me wait for 2–3 hours for an order that was supposed to arrive in 30 minutes, and after multiple chats and calls with customer support, the final response is always the same: “We’re sorry. Your refund has been initiated.”

A refund does not compensate for the wasted time, inconvenience, hunger, or frustration. If your platform cannot ensure reliable coordination between restaurants and delivery partners, customers should not have to suffer repeatedly.

As a long-time Gold member, I expected much better. Unfortunately, these delivery issues have become far too frequent, and my confidence in Zomato has significantly declined. I sincerely hope the company focuses on improving its delivery operations instead of simply apologizing and issuing refunds after hours of waiting.

reviews.author: Niteshhhhqas
reviews.body:
This was the absolute worst food delivery experience. I ordered food during my train journey using my PNR, which means I rely completely on the restaurant to provide proper packaging and cutlery. Instead, the packaging was pathetic and completely messy. Worse, they did not provide a spoon or a plate. How is a passenger supposed to eat on a moving train without basic cutlery?
On top of the terrible packaging, an actual food item was missing from my order. When I contacted Zomato support regarding the missing food, the missing cutlery, and the worst packaging, they offered zero help. The support agent tried calling the restaurant, but the restaurant ignored the calls. Now, Zomato is refusing to process my refund for the missing item until the restaurant confirms the mistake. I am stuck traveling without the food I paid for, unable to properly eat what did arrive, and Zomato refuses to take any accountability just because their partner won't answer the phone. Pathetic customer service.

reviews.author: Pihu606
reviews.body:
I placed an order this evening which was supposed to be delivered in 51 minutes. I ordered it from the same city so I would get it as soon as possible. I placed the order around 7:30 PM, but it got so delayed that it was 9:00 PM and the order still hadn’t arrived, even though it was from the same city. Then I messaged the delivery partner but got no reply. And the delivery partner had a 5-star rating. I’m surprised — if a 5-star rated partner behaves like this, then how bad must the lower-rated ones be? No reply, and so much delay in delivering the order. After that I contacted Zomato’s customer support team and requested them to cancel my order because by that time I had already had dinner. I didn’t want the order anymore, and by now the food would have gone cold anyway. Their team told me to wait till 9:01 PM, and if the order doesn’t arrive we will refund the amount. I waited. Even after that the order didn’t arrive, and then their team just ended the chat from their side. My mistake was that I made the advance payment. If I hadn’t, they would have somehow made sure the order got delivered. But no, they did the opposite. 
Then I spoke to another person from their team and they said they will contact the delivery partner. But that 5-star rated delivery partner didn’t even pick up their call. On top of that I found out that he had marked the order as "delivered". It feels like the customer who pays in advance is the fool here, trusting this app and their team. But when it comes to giving money back, suddenly all their rules appear. 
My experience was very bad. I hope people read this before using this app.

reviews.body: First the app said delivery will be in 30 minutes, after 5 minutes the app said 3 minutes, I was like wow, so I came down to collect the order, I ordered the food at 1:20 pm, and I am writing this review at 2:20 pm with frustration, I am sitting outside from 50 minutes to collect the order, I stay in fourth floor, I can’t go up too, because every refresh it’s saying just 3 minutes, when I clicked help and support, chatbot said ”it’ll arrive at 2:17 pm due to delay” it’s 2:23 pm now, literally 1 hour 3 minutes, and the distance between my home and restaurant is 2km, that too there will be no traffic at all, I can only go from my home and take the order within 15 minutes, as I ordered I can’t cancel also, 100% cancellation fee, I am hungry and I didn’t received my order, and I can’t cancel also 😡, worst customer service, not going to order again, if you are dare enough, if order doesn’t reach in time or 1 hour 100% refund 😡, as we’ll suffer with hunger and gastric know 😡

reviews.author: TanmBose
reviews.body:
Extremely disappointed with Zomato’s customer support. Their in-app chat support is practically useless. Instead of resolving issues, they simply ask customers to send an email to their grievance team. After I followed their instructions and submitted a detailed complaint requesting a refund for stale and poor-quality food, I received nothing but a generic response stating that they could not process any refund. They only claimed that they had “flagged the concern” without offering any actual resolution.

As a customer, I feel completely ignored. What’s the point of having chat support if every issue is redirected elsewhere, only to be rejected with a template response? Meanwhile, Zomato continues to charge platform fees, GST, delivery charges, and other taxes, but when there’s a genuine problem with an order, they fail to take responsibility.

Based on my experience, I would not recommend ordering through Zomato. If something goes wrong with your order, don’t expect meaningful customer support or a fair resolution. There are better food delivery platforms that value their customers far more than this.

reviews.author: Rai D
reviews.body:
I am extremely disappointed with the service and customer support provided by Zomato.

I received my order with a missing item. As a customer who has been using Zomato for many years, I immediately contacted customer support expecting a fair hearing and resolution. What disappointed me even more than the missing item was the way my complaint was handled.

Instead of listening to my concern, the customer care representative appeared unwilling to investigate the issue, abruptly ended the chat, and disconnected the call without properly addressing my complaint. I felt as though my genuine concern was dismissed and that I was being treated as if I was making a false claim.

What makes this particularly frustrating is that my order history clearly shows that I have been a regular customer for years and have never previously raised a complaint about a missing item. When a loyal customer reports an issue for the first time, the least they deserve is respectful communication and a sincere effort to verify and resolve the matter.

Mistakes can happen in any delivery service, but the true measure of customer care is how such situations are handled. Unfortunately, my experience with Zomato’s support team was rude, dismissive, and far below the standards I expected from a company of this scale.

I hope Zomato reviews this incident and improves the way genuine customer concerns are handled in the future.

reviews.author: Kathiravan28
reviews.body:
I placed an order from Geetham Restaurant, Medavakkam, and initially the app showed an estimated delivery time of 10 minutes. I had already paid ₹270 for the order.

When I contacted Zomato support, I was informed that the order would be delivered within 5 minutes. However, after waiting and checking again, I found that the delivery partner was nearly 10 km away from my location.

I contacted support a second time and was then informed that my order had been grouped with another order, which was causing the delay. This information was never communicated to me earlier. It is disappointing that the delivery timeline shown in the app was inaccurate and that I received conflicting updates from customer support.

After waiting for almost an hour, my order was cancelled. I have not received refund for the ₹270 that I paid. This experience has been extremely frustrating and unacceptable.

I request an immediate refund of the full amount and an explanation for why the order was delayed and mismanaged. So that I cancelled after such a long wait. Due to this poor experience, I have lost confidence in the service and do not intend to place orders through Zomato again unless this issue is resolved appropriately.

reviews.author: Aladdinonweb
reviews.body:
If I could give zero stars, I absolutely would. This app is nothing more than an exercise in frustration and deliberate deception.
Their business model appears to be built entirely on bait-and-switch tactics. When you place an order, the app confidently promises delivery within a "30-minute" window. This is a total lie. Without fail, 90% of my orders have been delayed, consistently arriving 90+ minutes later.
By the time the food actually turns up—if it arrives at all—it is inevitably stone-cold, soggy, and completely unappetising. There is zero regard for customer time or the quality of the service provided.
When you attempt to contact support, you are met with nothing but automated, canned responses that do absolutely nothing to rectify the situation or provide an honest explanation for the constant, systemic failures. It is an utter waste of money and time.
Save yourself the headache and use literally any other service. This organisation is completely incapable of fulfilling its own stated promises. Avoid at all costs.

reviews.author: Costumer so

My order arrived without the Coke that was included in the meal and that I had paid for. It's unacceptable to charge customers for a meal and then fail to provide all the items.
What made the experience even worse was the complete lack of support. When I tried calling to report the missing item, I was repeatedly told to "call from the registered number" despite already calling from the registered number linked to my order. As a result, I was left with no way to get the issue resolved.
I wasn't asking for anything special—just the complete order that I paid for. For a brand as large as Burger King, missing items and a dysfunctional support system are simply unacceptable. A disappointing end to what was supposed to be a small birthday treat before an important exam. Would not recommend.

reviews.author: Viks_21
reviews.body:
Pathetic experience and extremely disappointing service. I ordered a cake for a special occasion and expected timely delivery, but the entire experience turned into a nightmare. After waiting for more than an hour, I contacted customer support and was told the order was delayed by just 15 minutes. I waited again, but there was still no update. When I contacted them after another 20 minutes, they again repeated the same thing — “just 15 more minutes.”

reviews.author: Joseph Alias
reviews.body:
Here’s a polished version of your feedback that keeps your frustration and point clear while sounding strong and constructive:

Zomato really needs to bring back customer reviews and feedback visibility on restaurant menu pages. Removing reviews creates a huge problem for customers who rely on real experiences before ordering food. Do you honestly expect people to trust only AI-generated descriptions, ratings like 4.1, or random pictures while spending money on food for their family?

Ratings alone are not enough. What actually helps customers are the detailed notes and experiences shared by other users — things like food quality, portion size, freshness, packaging, consistency, and hygiene. You already had this feature before, and disabling it has made ordering much riskier.

I recently had a terrible experience ordering food for my family because there were no visible customer reviews to guide my decision. The food turned out awful, and my family literally asked me, “Where did you get this from?” That situation could have been avoided if genuine customer feedback had been available.

Also, what is the point of asking customers to leave feedback after delivery if those reviews are not being properly shown to help future customers make informed choices?

Please bring back visible customer reviews and detailed feedback sections. Real customer opinions matter far more than AI summaries or simple ratings.

reviews.author: RimiRoy0602
reviews.body: You need to be honest with your users while showing them real time food tracking. I had ordered my food at 8pm and it was delayed by 1hr 30 mins. For the second one the delivery partner had a vehicle issue which was not conveyed immediately. There is no point of food ordering app if it takes more than 3 hours to reach at one’s place. Please train your delivery partners to keep users updated as well as keep your UI honest. I don’t need to see 3mins away delayed stuck for  30 mins delay. Show me the exact time. A restaurant which is supposed to be barely 5-10mins from my place is taking more than 1 hour to reach me is a pathetic way to function that too in a metro city. Horrible experience on Mother’s Day. And now because of this inconvenience I cannot treat my mom. What a bad experience on such a beautiful occasion. So disappointed in you as a gold member, why am I even a gold member it’s useless.

reviews.author: Rk_6415
reviews.body:
I placed an order on Zomato with a promised delivery time of 30 minutes. The order was never delivered on time. When I contacted customer support, I was forced to deal with an so-called “AI executive” that had absolutely no logic, empathy, or accountability.
I had an important appointment and clearly explained that I could not keep waiting. Instead of resolving the issue, they told me to wait longer or else the food would be wasted. Why should I suffer because of your delivery failure? Is it my mistake that your system and delivery partner failed?
The conversation went on endlessly with no solution. Finally, they ended the chat without issuing a refund and now there is no way to contact a real human being. This is a completely unfair and unethical policy. By blocking human support, they conveniently keep the customer’s money without delivering the service.
This is nothing short of cheating customers. If a company takes money and neither delivers the product nor refunds it, that is fraud. I will be reporting this incident to the Consumer Court of India.
Customers, please be careful. This platform clearly prioritizes profit over basic customer rights. Extremely disappointed and angry with this experience.

reviews.author: Rahulkhond
reviews.body:
Dear Zomato Support Team,

I am writing to express my disappointment regarding a recent order experience on your platform.

On the night of the incident, we placed an order from McDonald’s at around 1:30 AM, and the app indicated an estimated delivery time of 45 minutes. However, when we checked the app at 2:30 AM, the order status still showed that the food had not yet been prepared or picked up for delivery.

Since there was no progress on the order, we contacted your support through chat. Only then were we informed that the restaurant was already closed and the order would not be delivered. This was extremely frustrating, especially considering the late hour when ordering alternatives is difficult.

While the refund was processed and credited back to my account after 3 days, there was no compensation provided for the inconvenience caused. More importantly, this is not the first time this has happened. In fact, this is the third time I have faced the exact same issue where an order is accepted late at night but later cancelled because the restaurant is closed.

As a regular user of your platform, I expect better coordination between the app and the restaurants listed on it. Orders should not be accepted if the restaurant is closed or about to close, especially during late-night hours.

I request that you review this issue seriously, provide a reasonable compensation for the inconvenience, and take steps to ensure such incidents do not happen again.

Looking forward to your response.

Regards,
Rahul Khond

reviews.author: Manishbhat

I recently had a very frustrating experience with Zomato’s delivery and customer support.

A few days ago, my order was delayed because the delivery partner informed me that the navigation in the app was not working properly, due to which he was unable to reach my location easily. Because of this technical issue, my order got delayed and I had to wait longer than expected.

To resolve the problem, I contacted Zomato customer support multiple times. However, each time after a short reply, the chat was closed from their side. This forced me to start a new chat again and explain the entire issue from the beginning. I had to repeat the same problem several times, which was extremely frustrating and time-consuming.

When I requested compensation for the inconvenience caused by both the technical issue and the poor support experience, my request was declined by the support team, even though the issue was clearly related to the app’s navigation problem.

As a regular customer, I expected better assistance and a smoother resolution process. Instead, the experience was disappointing and made me question the reliability of their customer support system.

I hope Zomato improves its app navigation system and also ensures that customer support handles such issues more responsibly without repeatedly closing chats and forcing customers to start over again.

reviews.author: Joydeep Bag
reviews.body:
Zomato needs to seriously address its delayed delivery issue. When placing an order, the app shows an estimated delivery time, and customers make their decision based on that timeline. However, after placing the order, there are frequent delays — either the delivery partner is assigned late or they deliver nearby orders first before reaching you.

As a result, the actual delivery time is often at least 30 minutes later than the originally promised time. This is not an occasional issue; it happens almost every time, especially during peak evening hours between 7 PM and 10 PM.

This is a serious concern. It feels like the estimated time shown while ordering is not realistic, possibly to encourage more orders. If the app displayed the actual expected time (for example, 1.5 hours for a 3 km distance), many customers might reconsider placing the order. Transparency in delivery timelines is essential for maintaining customer trust.

reviews.author: SN0608

Zomato’s slow descent from a useful food discovery platform to a glorified billboard for mediocrity is complete. By removing long-form reviews, they’ve silenced the one part of their ecosystem that actually told the truth. The app now resembles a marketplace of inflated ratings and photoshopped food shots, doing little more than promoting restaurants that pay for visibility rather than those that deserve it.

Zomato once helped food lovers discover genuine gems based on nuanced reviews and honest experiences. Now, it actively hides honest feedback behind meaningless emojis and shallow one-liners. The result? You scroll through endless “4.5-star” places, only to end up at joints serving cold, greasy food that no amount of “recommended” tags can redeem.

This is not a “community-driven” food platform anymore. It’s an advertising engine dressed up as a dining guide — pushing mediocrity while pretending to celebrate culinary discovery. If you want transparency or thoughtful opinions, you won’t find them here anymore. Zomato has officially traded trust for traffic.

reviews.author: inder@561

One of the best features is the comprehensive collection of user reviews and ratings. These provide valuable insights into the quality of the restaurant and its dishes. I appreciate how Zomato encourages users to share their honest opinions, which helps others make informed decisions.

The app's ability to show real-time availability, menus, and even offer online ordering in some places adds to its convenience. The option to make reservations through Zomato has saved me time and hassle on numerous occasions.

However, there have been a few instances of outdated information or incorrect operating hours, which can be frustrating. Despite this occasional glitch, Zomato remains an essential tool for discovering new culinary experiences and making the most of your dining adventures. Whether you're a local or a traveler, Zomato is your reliable companion for navigating the world of food.

My recent experience with Zomato has solidified my decision to reconsider using this service, despite being a Zomato Gold member. This isn't an isolated incident; delays are now a recurring issue on almost every order, constantly pushing back ETAs. For this particular order, delivery was 23 minutes past the final revised ETA, attributed vaguely to "heavy traffic."
The food quality was equally concerning. The Dal Makhani was severely undercooked and inedible. When I reported this, I was simply told to email support, with no immediate resolution or acknowledgment of receiving spoiled food.
The customer support experience was utterly abysmal. Despite clearly stating I didn't want to interact with AI, I was repeatedly shunted back to automated responses. Human agents were unhelpful, failing to offer genuine solutions for delays, and misinterpreting my questions about compensation as "denial," leading to a downgraded offer. As a Gold member, I expect a significantly higher standard of service. The current performance, from inconsistent delivery to inedible food and frustrating customer support, is a huge letdown. reviews.body:
Nestled in the serene locale of Assagao, North Goa, Bawri offers a dining experience that stands out. With both normal and water-side seating, it caters to romantic couples and families alike, providing an elegant yet cozy atmosphere.

Starters
Yogurt Kebabs: A delightful fusion of flavors, these kebabs felt like a playful plate of chaat with tangy chutneys and a chole topping. An absolute treat!
Smoked Prawns: The highlight of the starters—tender, perfectly cooked prawns with a smoky, charred flavor that leaves a lasting impression.
Main Course
Bawri Handi: A wholesome vegetarian delight featuring a thick spinach-based gravy with a medley of broccoli, paneer, carrots, corn, and beans. It was a unique flavor that paired beautifully with lacchha paratha.
Veg Biryani: Aromatic, flavorful, and beautifully spiced—this biryani was a hit for its perfect balance of flavors.
Beverages
Kanji Lime Iced Tea: A refreshing summer drink with bold flavors that make it stand out.
Mango Bite: A crowd-favorite mango mocktail that is refreshingly sweet and satisfying.
Hibiscus Cranberry Lemonade: A bold and creative lemonade variation with a hint of hibiscus and the vibrant taste of cranberry.
Dessert
Bawri Jamun: The perfect end to the meal—gulab jamuns stuffed with rich khava and drizzled with creamy rabdi. Pure indulgence!
With its remarkable dishes, innovative drinks, and charming setting, Bawri makes for a memorable dining experience.

reviews.author: _Arsh__
reviews.body:
I’ve been using the Zomato app for a while now, and overall, it’s a great tool for food lovers. The app is easy to navigate, with a clean interface that makes searching for restaurants and browsing menus a breeze.

Pros:

•User-Friendly Interface: The layout is intuitive and simple to use, whether you’re searching for local places or specific cuisines.
•Wide Range of Restaurants: Zomato offers a vast selection of eateries, from high-end restaurants to local joints, ensuring you always have options.
•Detailed Menus and Reviews: The app provides comprehensive menus with prices, and the user reviews often help in choosing the best dish.
•Real-Time Order Tracking: When ordering delivery, I like the live tracking feature, so I know exactly when my food will arrive.
•Discounts and Offers: Zomato offers various deals and discounts, which is a big plus for frequent users.

Cons:

•Occasional Delays: Sometimes, there’s a delay in delivery, even though the app shows everything is on time.
•Customer Support: While the support is generally responsive, there are occasions when resolving issues takes longer than expected.
•Inconsistent Information: Some restaurant listings may have outdated menus or incorrect operational hours.

In conclusion, Zomato is a must-have app for anyone who enjoys exploring food options, whether dining in or getting food delivered. There’s room for improvement, especially with delivery times and information accuracy, but overall it’s a solid app for foodies.

reviews.author: Worst Food Application
reviews.body:
I am beyond frustrated and extremely dissatisfied with Zomato's food delivery app and its terrible service. The app failed repeatedly to accept or update my delivery address, which is a basic functionality every delivery service should get right. To make matters worse, Zomato doesn't offer any way to simply change the address or fix the issue; instead, the only option they provide is to cancel the order—and when you cancel, they deduct the full amount as if it was your fault. This is nothing short of a scam, where Zomato profits off customer mistakes or their own app failures.

This isn’t an isolated incident; it has happened multiple times, and each time the result is the same: an unresponsive app, no way to change the delivery address, and a full cancellation fee that makes no sense. The fact that they refuse to fix this problem or offer any kind of resolution is disgraceful. Zomato is clearly more interested in taking advantage of its customers than providing a reliable service.

I expect better from a major service provider, and this experience has made me rethink ever using Zomato again. This kind of app failure and unjustifiable cancellation policy is unacceptable. I demand a full refund for the cancellation charges and a serious overhaul of your app’s functionality. You cannot continue treating customers this way and get away with it.

reviews.body:
Zomato’s delivery service is nothing short of fantastic. From the moment I place my order to the time it arrives at my doorstep, everything is handled with precision and efficiency. The delivery time is spot on, with updates every step of the way, so I never had to wonder when my food would arrive.

But what truly sets Zomato apart is their exceptional customer service. I encountered issues with few of my orders, and their support team always resolved it almost immediately. Their quick responses, professionalism, and genuine care for customer satisfaction were impressive.

Zomato ensures that every experience, from delivery to service, is smooth and hassle-free. I’m thoroughly impressed and would recommend them without hesitation!

reviews.author: mr_abhineet
reviews.body:
This is not the first time Zomato has failed to uphold basic standards of quality and customer service, and it seems like they just don’t care about their customers anymore. I recently ordered a Chicken Rice Bowl Meal from KFC, and what I received was completely inedible—cold, hard rice and tough, cold chicken. It was clear that the food was stale and not safe to consume.

Despite the high prices we pay for food these days, Zomato seems completely indifferent to quality. I contacted them immediately, asking them to take the order back due to health concerns, and they didn’t even bother to respond. It’s shocking that Zomato can’t handle such basic issues, especially when this has been a recurring problem for me and others.

For the prices we’re paying, the least they can do is ensure the food is fresh and edible. Zomato’s lack of accountability and responsiveness is disgraceful, and they should seriously reconsider their approach to customer service before losing more loyal customers. I’ve had enough of paying for subpar, unsafe food with zero support from Zomato.
